resources.string: Use this only when local configuration is missing or corrupt. It recreates cleanup settings with empty rules and ordering and Show all mode, then synchronizes them to the system Hook. It does not restore or modify Root-disabled components. An older running Hook may retain effects until system acknowledgment. To preserve existing rules, cancel, try Restore remote configuration and export a backup first.
When validation fails, scan results are not updated; selected rules can still be managed.
